meta.name: Portfolio Snapshot + One Pager data dictionary
meta.purpose: Static, queryable source-of-meaning for the data-traceability chatbot. Holds what each field MEANS, where it comes from (per basis), and the RULE that picks the basis. The live per-deal pick is still done by the app resolver; basis_selection here is the general, explanatory version.
meta.consumed_by: lookup_field(field_id, basis=None) tool in the chatbot
meta.audience: analysts — internal table and column names in `source` are fine to show

answer_format.rule: Lead with the plain sentence, then one 'Source:' line as '<origin phrase> — <source>'. Never lead with a table or database name. If a field/basis is absent or status is needs_trace, say there is no verified source and do not guess.
answer_format.example: "The current outstanding loan balance as of quarter-end. Source: Comes from MRI — ISBS_Download (Interim BS), accounts 2150/2152/2210."

structural_principles.tab_aware: Some fields (debt, total_pref) resolve differently by tab. basis_selection is keyed by tab where so; answer for the tab the user names.
structural_principles.display_vs_computed: For ltv, ytd_dscr and debt_yield the ordered conditions are DISPLAY precedence only. The stored/raw field is always the computed figure, and that is what subtotals and guardrails read. Manual entries and suppressions change what is shown, never what is aggregated.
structural_principles.field_id_is_the_enum: Constrain the tool's field_id argument to this closed list; validate basis inside the tool against the chosen field's own bases (omitted or unknown basis -> return all bases).

origins.csv: Comes from a CSV / spreadsheet loaded into the app

meta.open_confirm: The *_Download tables (ISBS_Download, MRI_Occupancy_Download, MRI_Budget_Econ_Occ) are marked origin 'mri' but load via an MRI download — confirm once whether they arrive as CSV imports; if so, flip their origin to 'csv'.

fields.tab_notes: The same deal can legitimately show THREE different debt numbers by design: the One Pager prints hard costs for a development deal, the Snapshot prints the committed facility, and debt_isbs carries the drawn balance. Always answer for the tab the user names.

basis_selection.one_pager: In order: (1) if the balance sheet has usable debt-account rows -> the ISBS drawn balance (isbs); (2) else if the deal has loan rows -> the committed loan amount (orig_loan; a portfolio parent inherits its children's loans only if their rate + maturity + type match); (3) else $0 (none). Then, for development deals only, if hard-costs inspection rows exist they OVERRIDE the above with hard costs (a $0 hard-costs figure still overrides; no inspection row — 18 of 26 dev deals — leaves the earlier figure). The pre-override drawn balance is preserved as debt_isbs.
basis_selection.snapshot: resolve_debt (both Financial and Loan subtabs): non-development -> the ISBS drawn balance (isbs); development WITH a loan facility on record -> the committed loan amount (orig_loan / BASIS_COMMITTED); development with NO facility -> unavailable (deliberately NOT a fall-back to the ISBS balance, which the dev branch exists to distrust). The Snapshot never uses hard costs — that basis is One-Pager only.
basis_selection.display_suppression: Applies on top, raw values never move: debt-free deals (Pegasus / P0000066) show a dash; sold deals show a dash and drop out of Total Cap's debt leg; foreclosure and PDF n/a maps (City West, Pegasus) blank specific cells.

bases.plain: The current outstanding loan balance from the balance sheet, as of quarter-end.
bases.source: ISBS_Download (vSource 'Interim BS'), accounts 2150 / 2152 / 2210; most recent balance on or before quarter-end.
bases.caveats: A measured $0 can mean 'balance-sheet rows exist but no debt accounts' or 'paid off'.

bases.plain: Hard costs drawn to date on a development deal. Can legitimately be $0 before construction draws begin.
bases.source: MRI_Inspection.mHardCosts, summed over all draw rows. One Pager only.
bases.caveats: JB Fair Park and Jefferson Stephens show a real $0 here while the Snapshot shows the ISBS balance — the tabs intentionally differ.

bases.plain: The original committed loan amount — shown because the deal has no balance-sheet balance yet, e.g. a new/undrawn deal, or on the Snapshot for a development deal with a facility.
bases.source: MRI_Loans.mOrigLoanAmt (committed facility).
bases.caveats: The stored debt_basis label mislabels this as ISBS on the One Pager path; the resolver identifies the branch correctly. Fix queued at :632.

bases.plain: $0 — no balance-sheet balance and no loan rolled up. May be a data gap, not a true zero.
bases.source: Seed value.
bases.caveats: Seen on parent deals whose child loan does not inherit (Donald Lynch / P0000049).

fields.tab_notes: Includes sold deals, which is why the Snapshot figure exceeds the Executive Summary by the sold deals' combined Total Pref.

basis_selection.source_figure: (1) committed pref = sum of |Amt| over commitment rows (non-OP investors, EffectiveDate <= quarter-end) -> 'commitment rows'; (2) if that is zero but funded pref exists -> use funded pref, 'funded (no commitment row)' (this can only raise a zero, since contributed capital is committed by definition; fires for East Manchester and City West); (3) both zero -> 'none'.
basis_selection.what_prints: The committed value (commitment_basis = 'committed_pe'). The funded fallback is re-checked at print time rather than trusted, because the payload can arrive from an un-deployed backend serving the pre-fallback 0.0.
basis_selection.related: Ptr Equity stays on the funded basis deliberately (committing both would double-count Brainerd's OP row by $10.6M). Invested always scales funded pref; Total Commitment scales whatever Total Pref printed; Un-funded = Total Commitment - Invested.

bases.plain: Total committed preferred equity, from the deal's commitment rows.
bases.source: accounting_feed.Amt where MajorType ~ 'contrib' AND Typename ~ 'commitment', non-OP, EffectiveDate <= quarter-end, absolute sum; joined InvestmentID -> vcode.
bases.caveats: The app reads committed pref from IA_Contribution (Commitment-typed rows); the PDF reads IA_Commitment, a different table — a basis difference, not a bug.

bases.plain: The funded preferred equity, shown when the deal has no commitment row at all.
bases.source: Equals funded pref (field pref_equity), from accounting_feed.Amt.
bases.caveats: East Manchester, City West.

bases.plain: No committed and no funded pref found — $0.
bases.source: Seed value.

fields.basis_selection: Non-OP investors' contributions netted by sign over contribution and return-of-capital rows (commitment rows skipped); OP* investors route to partner_equity instead.

bases.plain: Funded preferred equity: contributions netted by sign for non-operating-partner investors, floored at zero.
bases.source: accounting_feed.Amt; InvestorID NOT starting 'OP'; running balance netted by sign; max(0) per investor.
bases.caveats: max(0) floors an over-returned investor at zero.

fields.basis_selection: Same contribution-netting rule as funded pref, but only for investors whose InvestorID starts 'OP'. Kept on the funded basis on purpose.

bases.plain: Operating-partner equity: the funded-pref rule applied to operating-partner investors.
bases.source: accounting_feed.Amt, InvestorID starting 'OP'.
bases.caveats: The 'OP' prefix is the ONLY test separating partner from preferred equity. Whether every operating-partner ID is OP-prefixed is an open Alay question.

fields.basis_selection: Always scales funded pref (does not follow the committed/funded switch, to keep tying the PDF).

bases.plain: The funded portion of TIAA's preferred-equity commitment (capital contributed to date).
bases.source: Scales funded_pref; NEEDS TRACE for the exact scaling field.
bases.caveats: Includes the four sold deals ($23.8M combined).

fields.basis_selection: Always Total Commitment minus Invested.

bases.plain: Remaining commitment still to be funded: Total Commitment minus Invested.
bases.source: Computed from Total Commitment and Invested.
bases.caveats: A deal can be genuinely part-funded at quarter-end (Burton at 51%) and self-correct to $0 next quarter.

fields.basis_selection: Scales whatever Total Pref printed (both bases carried as total_commitment_if_funded / _if_committed).

bases.plain: TIAA's total committed capital to the deal (funded plus un-funded).
bases.source: NEEDS TRACE; related to the committed-pref path.
bases.caveats: Includes the four sold deals.

fields.basis_selection: At subtotal/portfolio level, committed-weighted: sum of Total Commitment divided by sum of Total Pref. Scaling uses lookthrough_pct_pe (PE-basis, excluding OP owners), since the dollars scaled already exclude the OP stake.

bases.plain: TIAA's commitment as a share of the deal's total preferred equity.
bases.source: Computed: Σ Total Commitment ÷ Σ Total Pref.
bases.caveats: Deliberately a different basis than the PDF (Invested ÷ Total Pref). Three bases exist; the app uses committed-weighted.

fields.basis_selection: Re-footed as debt leg + Total Pref + Ptr Equity using the PRINTED debt (committed-on-dev), so the four columns sum. total_cap_isbs and total_cap_funded keep the ISBS debt leg / funded pref respectively.

bases.plain: Total capitalization: Debt + Total Pref + Partner Equity (Debt counted as 0 when n/a).
bases.source: Computed from the three components.
bases.caveats: For sold deals the debt leg is zeroed out of Total Cap while Debt and Total Pref lines keep raw values.

fields.basis_selection: Per-deal is an analyst entry; subtotals/totals self-sum the member deals' entries (blank, never 0, if none entered).

bases.plain: Inception-to-date distributions, entered by an analyst per deal.
bases.source: portfolio_snapshot_values. The per-deal fee-allocation formula (footnote 1) is still TBD.
bases.caveats: Excluding-Development ITD can exceed Portfolio Total because development deals carry negative ITD.

bases.plain: A subtotal / total: the sum of the member deals' entered ITD.
bases.source: Sum over member deals that have an entry; blank if none.

fields.basis_selection: Always an analyst entry; no system formula. Foreclosure deals (City West) are not enterable; normal-sale deals (East Manchester, Camarillo, Outlook) are enterable.

bases.plain: Net return on equity, entered by an analyst. No system formula exists yet.
bases.source: portfolio_snapshot_values (formula TBD).
bases.caveats: City West (foreclosure) excluded; normal sales enterable as realized returns.

fields.tab_notes: Displayed in percentage points, not a ratio.
fields.basis_selection: In order: (1) deal in the temporary-suppression list (Hanestowne / P0000118) -> n/a 'TEMPORARY per-deal suppression'; (2) owned < 3 months -> n/a 'insufficient operating history' (fails open if no close date on the payload); (3) development deal, unless exempted -> n/a 'dev'; (4) otherwise the first available of projected_ye -> ytd_actual -> at_close, and the basis names which was taken. Subtotals are NOI-weighted over visible rows only.

bases.plain: Average physical occupancy year-to-date, less bad-debt / concession points.
bases.source: MRI_Occupancy_Download 'Occ%' averaged Jan 1 -> quarter-end; bad-debt leg from Interim IS accounts 4040/4043 over 4010.

bases.plain: Actual months at actual occupancy plus remaining months at budget occupancy, divided by 12.
bases.source: ytd_actual blended with MRI_Budget_Econ_Occ.PctOccupied for remaining months.
bases.caveats: Q4 or missing budget falls back to ytd_actual.

bases.plain: The economic occupancy recorded at acquisition (stored, not computed).
bases.source: Prop_Info_DealTerms.econ_occ_at_close.
bases.caveats: A data-entry field; a blank is a gap in MRI.

bases.plain: Occupancy intentionally not shown — temporary suppression, insufficient history, or a development deal.
bases.source: Suppression reason set in portfolio_snapshot_operating.
bases.caveats: A 'why is it blank' answer, not a source.

fields.basis_selection: (1) if the At-Close table has the deal -> that figure (revenue/NOI negated, plus a 7070 tax-abatement fold-in); (2) else the earliest December Projected IS (YTD-cumulative); (3) a Year-0 gate zeroes it ONLY when the deal is development (or force-suppressed, {P0000066}) AND has no 2015-12-31 Projected IS row — both required, or nine non-dev deals would wrongly zero; (4) a fully-zeroed column is emitted as a dash (None), not a measured $0.

bases.plain: Net operating income underwritten at acquisition.
bases.source: Prop_Info_AtClose (at_close_noi etc.).
bases.caveats: The exact account set lives in Prop_Info_AtClose.sql — whether it matches IS_ACCOUNTS and nets 7083 is an open Joe question. Many deals carry a 2015-12-31 date (upstream defect).

fields.basis_selection: The last December Projected IS snapshot in the report year (YTD-cumulative = full year). No December row -> blank. Suppressed to n/a on Operating by the same temporary/history/dev gate (with DEV_DISPLAY_EXCEPTIONS, currently P0000078 for noi).

bases.plain: Underwritten year-end NOI, read as the December Projected IS snapshot.
bases.source: ISBS_Download vSource 'Projected IS', last December of the report year; IS_ACCOUNTS revenue/expense sets plus 7070.

fields.basis_selection: Keyed on whether current-year actuals exist: (1) actuals + budget -> YTD actual + remaining-year budget; (2) actuals, no budget -> = YTD actual; (3) no actuals, budget -> full-year budget; (4) neither -> blank. When a year has no budget the prior year's budget is shifted forward 12 months — EXCEPT for development deals (their prior year is a non-repeating lease-up), which drops them to case 2 (Projected YE = YTD Actual, YTD Budget = 0).

bases.plain: Year-to-date actual NOI plus the remainder of the year at budget.
bases.source: ISBS Interim IS (YTD cumulative, to quarter-end) plus Budget IS summed over the rest of the year.
bases.caveats: The two legs are different bases by design; correct because Interim IS is YTD-cumulative.

fields.basis_selection: Always computed from the NOI values (growth function over the underwriting triple).

bases.plain: Growth from one NOI point to a later NOI point in the underwriting triple.
bases.source: Computed via the growth function over the NOI values.

fields.basis_selection: Always computed from the NOI values.

bases.plain: Realized growth across the NOI triple.
bases.source: Computed via the growth function over the NOI values.

fields.basis_selection: Always an analyst entry.

bases.plain: Free-text operating commentary written by an analyst.
bases.source: Analyst entry (read-only prose on the subtab).

fields.basis_selection: Always from the loan terms; N/A for debt-free deals, blank for sold deals.

bases.plain: The loan's interest rate / index / spread.
bases.source: MRI_Loans columns (vIntType, vIndex, vSpread, nRate).
bases.caveats: N/A for debt-free, blank for sold.

fields.basis_selection: Always from the loan record; N/A for debt-free, blank for sold.

bases.plain: The loan's maturity date.
bases.source: MRI_Loans.dtMaturity, falling back to dtEvent.

fields.basis_selection: DISPLAY precedence (the raw field is ALWAYS the computed figure, which is what subtotals weight): (1) debt-free -> N/A; (2) development -> 'Dev' (unconditional since 2026-09-01); (3) a seeded/typed manual entry -> that entry (a stored blank stays a dash); (4) Giant 7 (P0000019) fallback when computed is None and not dev -> the One Pager's projected-YE DSCR; (5) otherwise the computed YTD DSCR.
fields.aggregates_use: the computed figure (ytd_dscr_computed), debt-weighted; manual/display overrides never reach subtotals.

bases.plain: Year-to-date debt service coverage: YTD NOI divided by (interest + principal balance change).
bases.source: Interim IS NOI ÷ (account 5190 interest + balance-sheet principal movement across 2150/2152/2210); payoff months substituted, not account 7060, to avoid double-counting.
bases.caveats: Debt-weighted at subtotal. Unlabelled refinancings (The Gallery, Pontchartrain, PMAT) can overstate the denominator until corrected in MRI (Alay). Debt service of 0 -> None.

bases.plain: A value entered by an analyst, overriding the computed figure for display only.
bases.source: portfolio_snapshot_values (MANUAL_RATIO_SEEDS, 4 vcodes).
bases.caveats: 'pre-filled — editable' = an unreviewed seed, not an affirmed entry.

fields.basis_selection: DISPLAY precedence (raw is ALWAYS the computed figure): (1) debt-free -> N/A; (2) development -> 'Dev'; (3) a seeded manual entry (all six seeded deals lack a qualifying valuation anyway); (4) debt and valuation both present -> debt ÷ valuation, but WITHHELD and flagged if the raw ratio exceeds 150% ('likely stale debt'); (5) no valuation -> dash, flagged.
fields.aggregates_use: the computed figure, debt-weighted over deals with a displayed value.

bases.plain: Loan-to-value: debt divided by valuation.
bases.source: debt ÷ valuation. Valuation = most recent concluded value (mIncomeCapConcludedValue) on/before the prior year-end (Q4 uses its own year-end).
bases.caveats: Withheld above the 150% ceiling. Numerator is the same resolve_debt figure, so a dev deal's LTV is committed-over-value. Date parsing is format='mixed' (load-bearing).

bases.plain: An analyst-entered LTV overriding the computed figure for display only.
bases.source: portfolio_snapshot_values (MANUAL_RATIO_SEEDS, 6 vcodes).
bases.caveats: 'pre-filled — editable' = an unreviewed seed.

fields.basis_selection: DISPLAY precedence (raw is ALWAYS the computed figure): (1) debt-free -> N/A; (2) development -> 'Dev'; (3) a seeded manual entry; (4) no debt -> n/a 'no debt balance'; (5) Giant 7 (P0000019) fallback (actual_ye ÷ debt) when quarter NOI is missing; (6) no complete quarter of actual NOI -> n/a; (7) otherwise single-quarter Interim IS NOI × 4 ÷ debt.
fields.aggregates_use: the computed figure; manual/display overrides never reach subtotals.

bases.plain: Debt yield: annualized quarter NOI divided by debt.
bases.source: single-quarter Interim IS NOI × 4 ÷ debt (config.IS_ACCOUNTS revenue/expense lists; a quarter missing any of its three months is dropped upstream, so 'incomplete quarter -> None').
bases.caveats: A YTD-annualised comparison basis is carried alongside; the two are equal at Q1 and diverge after.

bases.plain: An analyst-entered debt yield overriding the computed figure for display only.
bases.source: portfolio_snapshot_values (MANUAL_RATIO_SEEDS).
bases.caveats: 'pre-filled — editable' = an unreviewed seed.

fields.basis_selection: Always an analyst entry.

bases.plain: Free-text loan commentary written by an analyst.
bases.source: Analyst entry.

bases.plain: Share of the portfolio by asset type, on a currently-funded basis.
bases.source: Currently Funded ÷ Total Commitment, bucketed by asset type. NEEDS TRACE: confirm the exact 'Currently Funded' source field.

bases.plain: Share of the portfolio by deal type.
bases.source: NEEDS TRACE.

bases.plain: Deals left out of a Summary bucket, with the reason.
bases.source: NEEDS TRACE.

fields.basis_selection: is_sold_as_of: Sale_Status == 'SOLD' AND Sale_Date <= quarter-end (SOLD with no date -> treated as sold). Uses the quarter, not today's date, so history stays stable. Then: kept-despite-sold deals (City West, East Manchester, Camarillo, Outlook) stay on the page labelled '(Sold)', read at their last-held quarter, Debt blanked; foreclosure (City West) also blanks Net ROE; all other sold deals drop off. A parent with null Sale_Status is never treated as sold even if its child is.

bases.plain: Marks a deal sold as of the quarter.
bases.source: deals table Sale_Status == 'SOLD' AND Sale_Date <= quarter-end.
bases.caveats: On the One Pager a sold deal's debt is suppressed and its Total Cap debt leg zeroed; raw values retained. Any exception fails open (keeps reporting debt).

fields.basis_selection: is_dev_deal(strategy): strategy in DEV_STRATEGIES ({'development'} as of 2026-09-01; 'new construction' removed). Strategy = Investment_Strategy if populated, else Lifecycle (proxy). Today Investment_Strategy is 0/110 populated, so Lifecycle decides every classification. Unknown/unclassifiable -> not dev (safe direction).

bases.plain: Marks a development deal.
bases.source: Investment_Strategy, falling back to Lifecycle, on the deal's inv_map row; checked against config.DEV_STRATEGIES.
bases.caveats: Drives One Pager hard-costs debt, Snapshot committed-facility debt, the budget-shift carve-out, the At-Close Year-0 gate, Operating/Loan n/a, and the Excluding-Development subtotal — one definition so they can't disagree. 10 dev deals at 2026-Q2.
